_comment: Plan pages (/plans/<slug>) and plan facts. checkout = the backend plan key (Growth is premium, Scale is custom_plus). Prices, promo terms and fees must match Stripe.

howItWorks.title: Strategy call
howItWorks.text: A 30-minute call to review your market, lists, goals and how your team works today.

howItWorks.title: Checkout and onboarding
howItWorks.text: Subscribe, complete intake and share CRM and dialer access. We assign your caller and VA manager.

howItWorks.title: Setup in 48–72 hours
howItWorks.text: Script, lead criteria and routing are configured. Calling starts once onboarding and access are complete.

howItWorks.title: Calling, daily QA and reports
howItWorks.text: Seller leads arrive in your CRM with full MTCP notes: Motivation, Timeline, Condition and Price.

firstMonth.text: Kickoff, access set up, and your script and qualification rules agreed.
Calling starts. Daily KPI reports and call reviews begin.
QA coaching from real calls, plus list and script adjustments based on results.
KPI review with your VA manager and a plan for next month.
